patch_description:
Replace the nearest-reached-node greedy attachment with an exact directed Steiner dynamic program for broadcast-sized destination sets. The dynamic program jointly selects relay paths and branch points, charging each selected network edge once regardless of how many destinations reuse it. This avoids greedy choices that can prevent later destinations from sharing an inexpensive trunk.

For every subset of destinations and candidate relay node, the algorithm computes the minimum cost needed to broadcast from that node to the subset. It combines independently served subsets at a relay and relaxes those relay solutions backward across the directed network. The resulting root state is an optimal shared directed broadcast topology under additive edge costs. The topology is then expanded into root-to-destination paths for every partition, preserving shared prefixes for overlapping transfers.
